name: genpark-personal-agent-cortisol-awakening-response-car-adrenal-skill
title: Cortisol Awakening Response (CAR) & Adrenal Rhythm Skill
description: Salivary free cortisol awakening response (CAR) curve telemetry evaluation, HPA-axis adrenal burnout risk stratification, and morning photon flux lux/melanopic daylight pacing. Built for GenPark (https://www.genpark.ai).

tools.name: audit_cortisol_awakening_curve
tools.description: Evaluate 4-point diurnal salivary cortisol levels (Wake, Wake+30m, Afternoon, Night) to identify HPA axis dysregulation or flattened curve burnout.

tools.name: prescribe_circadian_light_pacing
tools.description: Calculate required morning lux exposure and evening melanopic light restrictions to re-anchor central suprachiasmatic nucleus (SCN) circadian phase.
